MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 11

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 43

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 9

8. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 7
   D. 6

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 13

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

18. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

19. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

20. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

22. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

24. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
